environment.database_role: migration integration gate; app-role credential/RLS assertions included

claims.behavior_proved: Temporary credentials and permanent passwords use distinct tenant-bound records. The lifecycle fixes temporary credentials at 72 hours, hashes secrets with Argon2id m=19456 KiB/t=2/p=1 and unique salts, verifies temporary values without consuming them, and establishes a permanent credential atomically with one-use consumption. Integration tests cover concurrent consumption, replay, duplicate-password rollback, persistence and tenant-isolated app-role access.
claims.path_proved: Four focused lifecycle unit tests pass. The PostgreSQL migration suite passes all 16 tests, including the credential schema, exact 72-hour expiry predicate, restricted app-role RLS/grants, atomic consume-and-establish, and concurrent use. Workspace typecheck and architecture gates pass.
claims.configuration_proved: Node v26.7.0, npm v12.2.0, PostgreSQL 18.0 / package build 18.0-2. Isolated test database and migration integration identities were used; no credentials are recorded. The application-role checks verify tenant isolation and denied delete behavior.
coverage_limitations: The local versioned password blocklist currently contains a small common-password sample, not a comprehensive compromised-password corpus.
